apiToken.description: Shared secret for the /api endpoints and the WebSocket API on /api/ws (Bitfocus Companion, external integrations). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `X-API-Token: <token>` or `?token=<token>`; over the WebSocket also as a `login` frame. When empty the API is unauthenticated, unless the sign-in (NodeCG login) is switched on — only safe if the server is not reachable from untrusted networks.

wsToken.description: The key of the WebSocket API on /api/ws (the Bitfocus Companion module). Send it as `?token=<key>` in the address, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, or in a `login` frame. When set, the WebSocket takes this key and not `apiToken`; when empty, `apiToken` is the key of the WebSocket too.

allowUnauthenticatedApi.description: Explicitly allow the /api endpoints to be used without a token. Ignored when apiToken is set.

hideApiState.description: Hide the `templates`/`outs` payloads from GET /api/state. Useful for very chatty Companion feedback polling.

defaultOutId.description: Id of the out created on first run.

language.description: Language of the example library and sample data seeded on first run: `en` or `ru`. Empty = the locale of the server process, else English. The dashboard itself follows each operator's browser and its EN/RU switch.

mediaDir.description: Каталог для медиа, загруженного перетаскиванием в редакторе. Пусто = <runtimeRoot>/assets/notGT/media (том assets в Docker).
